headline: Budi Arie Denies Connection to Treason Case Involving Listyo Sigit
seoTitle: Bareskrim Polri Questions Budi Arie Treason Case
metaDescription: Budi Arie Setiadi completed police questioning regarding a treason probe, denying involvement with suspects except for former police chief Listyo Sigit.
aiSummaryBullets: Budi Arie Setiadi stated he does not know the suspects in the alleged treason case, excluding former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
Budi Arie clarified that his previous public comments regarding the acceleration of the 2029 election are unrelated to the current treason investigation.
Bareskrim Polri also summoned former presidential assistant Devid Agus Yunanto, who failed to attend his scheduled questioning and was rescheduled for Monday.
aiContextParagraph: Bareskrim Polri is currently conducting an investigation into allegations of treason and illegal wiretapping targeting President Prabowo Subianto. As part of this inquiry, investigators summoned former Minister Budi Arie Setiadi and Devid Agus Yunanto, a former aide to the seventh president of Indonesia. Following his questioning, Budi Arie publicly distanced himself from the accused individuals, noting his only acquaintance among the suspects is former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo. He further addressed viral video footage in which he discussed the potential for moving up the 2029 election, asserting that these analytical remarks do not constitute treason. Meanwhile, authorities confirmed that Devid Agus Yunanto did not appear for his initial interview session and has been rescheduled for further questioning next week. The investigation remains a subject of significant media coverage.
whyItIsViral: The event is generating intense media coverage across five independent outlets with high velocity, focusing on the involvement of a former cabinet minister in a high-profile national security investigation.
